evidence_quotes: The Ministry of Religious Affairs Pusaka app is an official digital platform developed by the Ministry of Religious Affairs of the Republic of Indonesia (Kementerian Agama Republik Indonesia).

Officially named Pusaka SuperApps, the application is designed as a one-stop digital service portal, enabling the public to access various services and information provided by the Ministry of Religious Affairs.

The Pusaka application offers various public services, including access to religious information, Hajj and Umrah services, and education services and information to access Education Management Information System (EMIS).
It provides information on scholarships and educational assistance, as well as assists in the digitization of documents and certificates.
In response to the budget efficiency across ministries, the Pusaka app required cost optimization — without compromising end-user service quality.
